keyLimits.en: Bundles Cinema 4D, Redshift, ZBrush, Red Giant, and Universe under one subscription, with 'Save 30% or more' framed versus buying products individually with annual billing; includes access to 7,500+ Maxon Capsules and a training video library. Exact monthly-only price and full plan breakdown were not visible in the fetched page content.

cautions.en: The fetched pricing page did not render the actual pricing table in extracted content; figures here rely on the previously seeded/cached value and were not independently re-confirmed line by line in this session.

capabilities.en: Single subscription bundling Maxon's full 3D toolset: Cinema 4D (3D modeling/animation), Redshift (GPU renderer), ZBrush (digital sculpting), Red Giant (VFX/motion graphics plugins), and Universe.
Includes access to a library of 7,500+ ready-made Maxon Capsules (assets) and training videos.

limitations.en: No free tier; the suite is subscription-only, with annual billing offering the best discount versus monthly.
Full pricing table and per-app breakdown were not accessible in this session's page fetch, limiting confidence in exact figures.

reason.en: Free, open-source 3D suite covering much of the same modeling/animation/rendering workflow.
Competing professional 3D/VFX toolset, particularly for procedural and simulation work.

unknowns: Exact current monthly and annual prices could not be confirmed directly from the fetched page content in this session; relies on previously cached figures.
Whether a standalone Cinema 4D-only plan exists separate from the full Maxon One bundle was not confirmed.
